releases.notes:
✨ **Major Improvements**: Added the `Sulfur Cube`, fixed `Sheep` and `Rabbit` head loot tables, improved rabbit textures, and expanded version support. This release supports Minecraft Versions `1.21`–`26.2`.

**Details**:

- **Sulfur Cube**: Added a collectible Sulfur Cube head.
- **Sheep**: Fixed recursive loot-table errors and duplicate wool drops on older versions.
- **Rabbit**: Fixed variant detection, improved textures and naming, and corrected the special `Toast` head.
- **Improved Version Support**:
  - Improved `Slime` and `Magma Cube` size detection using compatible NBT checks.
  - Preserved the `Tears` music-disc drop from player-deflected fireballs.
  - Preserved the `Lava Chicken` music-disc drop from chicken jockeys when available.
  - Updated entity predicates and overlays for Minecraft `26.2`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nwrenger/more-heads/compare/0.4.0...0.5.0

releases.notes:
✨ **Major Improvements**: Added full version (i.e. snapshot) support, fixed wolf loot table for versions starting with `1.21.11`, reduced data pack/mod size drastically. This release supports Minecraft Versions `1.21`–`26.1.2`.

**Details**:

- **Full Version Support**: Reorganized overlay versions to perfectly align with when Minecraft added/changed each mob/feature.
- **Wolf Fixes**: Starting with version `1.21.11` Minecraft changed nbt data for angry mobs. This caused wolfs to always drop their `Angry` variant. This is now fixed.
- **Size Reductions**: Removed unnecessary tropical fish and pig overlays.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nwrenger/more-heads/compare/0.2.1...0.3.0
